scope: Static safety review of the additive RAG installer memory preflight; no EC2 commands or service changes.

finding.issue: Installer compared MemAvailable KiB with 720000 while its stated gate is 720 MiB. 720000 KiB is about 703.125 MiB, so hosts 17 MiB below the documented floor could pass.

checks.targeted_static_regression: passed: 720 * 1024 == 737280; old 720000 guard absent; error message and guard agree
